title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Jewelry Cap When a Claim Is Re-Settled After Recovery
content:
**Clause.** When a Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan claim is re-settled after stolen property is recovered, the jewelry, furs and watches value — both the value still missing and the value before recovery — is capped at the re-settlement's jewelry cap. The re-settlement's jewelry cap is the level's jewelry, furs and watches sublimit multiplied by 1.5 when the plan's effective date is 36 or more whole months before the loss date, by 1.2 when it is at least 12 and fewer than 36 whole months before the loss date, and by 1 otherwise.

| Plan's effective date, before the loss date | Multiplier on the jewelry sublimit |
| --- | --- |
| 36 whole months or more | 1.5 |
| 12 to 35 whole months | 1.2 |
| fewer than 12 whole months | 1 |

**Illustration (hypothetical).** With a sublimit of 540.00 and a plan effective 37 whole months before the loss date, the cap is 810.00: jewelry still missing of 600.00 counts in full, and jewelry before recovery of 900.00 counts at 810.00.
